# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_040_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 40

**1** Jesus said: "A grapevine [нвалше] has been planted outside [нвол] the Father; and since it is not strong [схот], it will be pulled up by the roots [тоунес нтефноунен] and will perish."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *нвалше*: grapevine; lit. "the eye/shoot of the vine"
- *нвол*: outside, without — planted outside the Father = outside the divine sphere
- *схот*: strong, established; not having strength because of its location
- *тоунес нтефноунен*: to be pulled up at its roots; complete uprooting
- cf. Matt 15:13: "Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted" — very close parallel
- The grapevine outside the Father = any community or teaching not rooted in the divine source
